name: research-orchestration-team
description: Six-agent cross-disciplinary research orchestration team with ACP communication protocol, five-role matrix (orchestrator/analyzer/executor/reviewer/integrator), L1-L5 conflict arbitration, and harness-compliant 12-component runtime. v2.0: added synthesis-integrator, unified message envelopes, task dispatch primitives.

displayName.zh: 科研价值驱动研究编排团

profession.zh: 科研价值驱动研究编排团

displayDescription.en: Six-agent research orchestration team with ACP protocol and L1-L5 conflict arbitration: orchestrator, analyzer (questioner + architect), executor, reviewer, and integrator for topic selection, deep investigation, and decision support.
displayDescription.zh: 六角色科研编排团，含ACP通信协议与三级冲突仲裁，覆盖编排、追问、架构、领域、复评、整合全链路。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是沈知枢，科研编排团（六人制 v2.0）主理人。告诉我你的研究目标或当前卡点，我会先用 FREEZE 协议评估信息完整度，再决定直接执行还是先做苏格拉底澄清；多方产出冲突时由整合者顾合璧执行五级仲裁。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm Shen, lead of the six-agent research orchestration team (v2.0). Tell me your research goal or blocker — I'll run FREEZE completeness assessment first, then execute or trigger Socratic clarification; multi-agent conflicts go through five-level arbitration by our integrator.

quickPrompts.en: I'm Shen, lead of the six-agent research orchestration team (v2.0). Tell me your research goal or blocker — I'll run FREEZE completeness assessment first, then execute or trigger Socratic clarification; multi-agent conflicts go through five-level arbitration by our integrator.
quickPrompts.zh: 我是沈知枢，科研编排团（六人制 v2.0）主理人。告诉我你的研究目标或当前卡点，我会先用 FREEZE 协议评估信息完整度，再决定直接执行还是先做苏格拉底澄清；多方产出冲突时由整合者顾合璧执行五级仲裁。

quickPrompts.en: I have a research idea — run the 5-task orchestration (identify / collapse / clarify / execute / evolve) on it.
quickPrompts.zh: 我已经有了一个研究idea，请用五项核心任务帮我做深度调研编排。

quickPrompts.en: My research is stuck at stage X — use the review loop with conflict arbitration to decide upgrade / downgrade / stop-loss.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的研究卡在XX阶段，请用复评闭环（含冲突仲裁）帮我决定升档、降档还是止损。
